title: BanG Dream! Releases Yumemita x Our Notes Story Trailer
content:
A story link trailer for BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA has been released, announcing that the story of the TV anime will continue in the upcoming game BanG Dream! Our Notes . A band visual was also released. The game also previously released an introduction trailer for the band.

A band visual was also released featuring the outfits the members wore in the final episode’s live performance:

NICHICALINE animated the first season with Tomomi Umezu as the director and Hiroshi Morita as the assistant director. Midori Goto was in charge of the series composition, while Osamu Nobusawa and Mochipuyo were in charge of character design. Crunchyroll and Muse Asia are streaming the series. The cast includes:

• Arale Nakamachi (vocals)

• Nonoka Miyanaga (lead guitar)

• Ritsu Minetsuki (rhythm guitar)

• Miyako Fuji (keyboard)

• Yuno Sengoku (DJ)

• Kaede Hondo as Viola

• Wakana Maruoka as Bell

• Yui Tsukada as Popo

• Runa Sanai as Manager

• Maaya Uchida as Koharu

• Konomi Kohara as Kaede

• Miho Okasaki as Yuina

BanG Dream! Our Notes weaves an all-new multi-route narrative across five distinct girl bands and a cast of 25 characters. Returning fan favorites MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica are joined by Mugendai MewType, millsage, and Ikka Dumb Rock!, each with their own dedicated story chapters. In this brand-new mobile game released under the BanG Dream! project, the story begins with the chapters of MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica, and gradually unfolds into a narrative woven by five girls’ bands. The game features narratives that portray the choices and growth of the girls’ bands both on stage and in their lives, combined with diverse gameplay mechanics to deliver a brand-new experience centered on youth and bonds—further expanding the BanG Dream! project’s expression in gaming.

To further elevate the storytelling experience, the game introduces its Cinematic Narrative System, bringing emotional moments to life through expressive character animation, dynamic performance sequences, richly illustrated story scenes, and storyboard-inspired cinematic cutscenes.

Players can revisit memorable moments from the MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica anime from a game-exclusive perspective while discovering brand-new stories that continue beyond the animated series. Meanwhile, Mugendai MewType, millsage, and Ikka Dumb Rock! each make their narrative debut with original story chapters exploring their unique personalities, relationships, and musical journeys. Source: BanG Dream! Our Notes Official X (formerly Twitter) ©BDP ©FTK ©BUSHI ©BHK

title: Professor Layton and the Curious Village Game Gets Remake
content:
Level 5 announced during the Level 5 Vision 2026 livestream on Thursday that its Professor Layton and the Curious Village ( Layton Kyōju to Fushigi na Machi ) game is getting a remake for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in 2027. The company streamed a trailer:

Level 5 also streamed a new trailer for its Professor Layton and The New World of Steam ( Layton Kyōju to Jōki no Shinsekai ) game :

The company also streamed a behind-the-scenes video for the game's theme song. Joe Hisaishi ( Studio Ghibli films) is composing the theme song "The New World" performed by Lilas.

The Professor Layton and the Curious Village game debuted for Nintendo DS in Japan in 2007 and the West in 2008. The game had ports for iOS, Android, and Panasonic 's DoCoMo P906i handset.

Professor Layton and The New World of Steam will launch on December 10 worldwide for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam . There is mouse support for all versions except Switch.

The game was previously slated for last year, but was delayed .

The game takes place after the events of Professor Layton and the Unwound Future , the franchise 's third Nintendo DS game. The setting is Steam Bison, America, where Luke has moved to and has invited Layton to visit. Yō Ōizumi returns to voice Layton, and Mio Imada is the new voice of Luke Triton.

The additional cast includes:

• Riho Yoshioka as Elinora and Elida

• Mahiro Takasugi as Eggmuffin

• Shin'ya Kote as Allinston

• Kōichi Yamadera as Sheriff Bobsley

• Akio Ōtsuka as Falcon

• Michaela Wako Sato as Mystella

Quiz Knock, a group specialized in creating puzzles and riddles for media, are in charge of the game's puzzles.

Layton's Mystery Journey: Katrielle and the Millionaire's Journey was the previous entry in the series. The game debuted in Japan for Nintendo 3DS and worldwide for iOS and Android devices in July 2017. The game then launched for Nintendo 3DS in the West in October 2017. The game launched for Switch in August 2018, and that version headed West in November 2019. The original game inspired the Layton Mystery Tanteisha: Katori no Nazotoki File television anime , which premiered in April 2018, and ended in March 2019.

Source : Level 5 Vision 2026 livestream

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Rises Back to #1, Sekiro: No Defeat Opens at #9 in Japan
content:
Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, rose from #2 to #1 in its seventh weekend in the Japan box office from Friday to Sunday, and sold 928,000 tickets to earn 1,415,274,600 yen (about US$9.23 million) over the three days.

The film has sold 9.60 million tickets and has earned a cumulative total of 13,895,602,400 yen (about US$90.70 million). The film has now surpassed Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi 's ( Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway ) 13.7 billion yen (about US$87.8 million) cumulative earning, and is currently the biggest film in Japan this year.

The film now ranks 23rd in Japan's all-time box office ranking.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.

The film's 4DX screenings began on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film will take place on September 11 and penlight screenings will take place on September 23.

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

The film's story begins with Chiik awa and Hachiware relaxing, when a rabbit with a flyer on its face suddenly appears. Hachiware looks at the flyer, which reads, "Invitation to a special island." Lured by tempting promises including great rewards for simple hunts on the island and essentially free sweet and spicy dishes such as limited-edition island ramen and sweets, Chiik awa and friends decide to go to the island. Suspicious with the flyer, Rakko goes with them to the island. What awaits them when they arrive on the island?

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, dropped from #1 to #3 in its second weekend. The film sold 217,000 tickets and earned 364,102,180 yen (about US$2.37 million) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 900,000 tickets and earned a cumulative total of 1,537,959,580 yen (about US$10.03 million).

The film got IMAX screenings in Japan on August 28, the same day it opened in theaters. The film sold 535,000 tickets and and earned 939,647,100 yen (about US$5.95 million) in its first three days.

Yukihiro Miyamoto ( Puella Magi Madoka Magica , Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) directed the film.

Shion Wakayama voices the new magical girl Shichōka and Tomoyo Kurosawa voices Selma Therese.

The anime film features a returning staff from the original anime series and films, including original creators Magica Quartet , chief director Akiyuki Simbo , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , original character designer Ume Aoki , animation character designer Junichirō Taniguchi , composer Yuki Kajiura , alternate space designer Gekidan Inu Curry , and animation studio SHAFT .

Yuki Kajiura 's solo project FictionJunction performs the theme song "Kanata."

Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon ( Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, dropped from #5 to #7 in its sixth weekend. The film earned 77,585,500 yen (about US$506,400) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 2,644,300,650 yen (about US$17.26 million).

The film ranked at #3 in its opening weekend. The film sold 441,000 tickets and earned 539,371,500 yen (about US$3.41 million) in its first three days.

The film opened in Japan on July 31.

The film centers on "the land of yōkai." The Nohara family go to Hiroshi's hometown of Akita to attend a famous fireworks festival during the summer. However, an incident causes yōkai to escape from their land and will wreak havoc in Akita, and in other areas throughout Japan. The Nohara family then go to the land of yōkai, and find themselves in a mysterious yet nostalgic world, where they go on an unpredictable adventure.

Sairi Itō stars in the film as Yako, a nine-tailed fox yōkai. Sakamoto of the comedy duo Mayurika plays the Squid Yōkai, first base player of the Edomae Sushies baseball team, which challenged Shi n-chan and his friends to a baseball game.

Other cast members include Yumiko Kobayashi , Miki Narahashi , Toshiyuki Morikawa , and Satomi Koorogi .

Masaki Watanabe ( Battle Spirits: Heroes , Sakamoto Days ) directed the film. Yoshiko Nakamura ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- franchise , PriPara ) penned the script. Shinei Animation , TV Asahi , ADK Emotions , and Futabasha produced the film, and TOHO is distributing. Singer TOMOO performs the film's theme song "Otona ni Nattara" (When I Become an Adult).

Kingdom: Tamashii no Kessen (Decisive Battle of the Soul), the fifth live-action film based on Yasuhisa Hara 's Kingdom manga, dropped from #7 to #8 in its eighth weekend. The film earned 89,448,200 yen (about US$583,800) over the weekend, and has earned a cumulative total of 6,562,769,200 yen (about US$42.83 million).

The new film opened in Japan on July 17. The film sold 993,000 tickets and earned 1,584,148,300 yen (about US$9.67 million) in its first three days. Counting the Marine Day holiday on July 20, the film sold 1,315,000 tickets and earned 2.064 billion yen (about US$12.59 million) in its first four days.

Yasuhisa Hara 's historical manga centers around the slave boy Xin and his dream of becoming a great general for the state of Qin. Xin helps Ying Zheng, the young Qin king who shares his desire to unify China, rise to power within the state. Xin does all he can to become a superior commander of an army capable of defeating the Seven Warring States.

Shinsuke Satō (live-action Gantz , Death Note Light up the NEW world , Bleach ) returned to direct. Tsutomu Kuroiwa ( Black Butler , Golden Kamuy ) wrote the screenplay with Hara. Yutaka Yamada ( Bleach , Golden Kamuy -The Hunt of Prisoners in Hokkaido- ) composed the music.

Sekiro: No Defeat , the new anime based on FromSoftware 's Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice game, opened at #9, and earned 99,842,200 yen (about US$649,000) in its first three days.

The anime began screening in theaters in Japan for three weeks starting on Friday.

Kenichi Kutsuna directed the anime at Qzil.la . Takuya Satou was the screenwriter. Takahiro Kishida ( Durarara!! ) designed the characters. Shūta Hasunuma composed the music.

The anime's theme song is "Blu" from composer Ryuichi Sakamoto 's The Best of 'Playing the Orchestra 2014' album.

The original game launched for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in March 2019, and it sold more than 2 million copies worldwide in less than 10 days.
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Screens in U.S., Canada on January 29
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it and Sony Pictures Entertainment will screen the Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) anime film on January 29, 2027 in the U.S. and Canada. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub . The company streamed a trailer:

International theatrical dates include:

• January 21 - Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates

• January 26 - Austria, Germany, Switzerland (German-speaking)

• January 27 - France, Belgium, Switzerland (French-speaking)

• January 28 - Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Central America, Ecuador, Colombia, Bolivia, Peru, Italy, Denmark, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Switzerland (Italian-speaking), Australia, New Zealand.

• January 29 - U.S., Canada, U.K., Ireland, Finland, Poland, Sweden, India

• February 5 - Spain, Kazakhstan

The film will feature a returning cast:

• Haruka Tomatsu as Aoko Aozaki

• Kana Hanazawa as Alice Kuonji

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Soujyuro Sizuki

The story of the original Witch on the Holy Night visual novel is set in the late 1980s, and centers on protagonist Aoko Aozaki, one of two sister heirs to a long family line of modern MAGES. Although she is disinterested in magic, she is suddenly declared as the heir of their family's magical art, and reluctantly begins her apprenticeship under Alice Kuonji, a young witch who lives in a lonely manor atop a hill. Aoko balances her duties of learning the arcane, while also serving as her school's student council president. She also makes the acquaintance of Sōjūrō Shizuki (romanized as Soujyuro Sizuki in the English version of the game), a new transfer student who is unfamiliar with much of the modern world, and contends with the plots of her older sister Tōko Aozaki, who feels that her birthright has been denied.

The original visual novel game's smartphone version will launch on November 20, the same day as the film's opening in Japan

Type-Moon most recently released the game on Steam in December 2023.

Aniplex released the PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch versions of the game in the West in December 2022, on the same day as the game's Japanese release date. The PS4 and Switch versions have sold more than 150,000 copies worldwide.

Mahōtsukai no Yoru was one of the first collaborations between Kinoko Nasu and artist Takashi Takeuchi in the mid-90s, preceding their founding of Type-Moon . Initially a novel, Nasu and Takeuchi only showed the draft to friends and did not officially release it. Type-Moon eventually developed it into a visual novel with graphics by Hirokazu Koyama that shipped in April 2012, with two sequels planned.

The story is noted for being one of the few tangible connections in the loosely connected "Nasuverse," the English-speaking fan term for the shared universe and cosmology in Type-Moon 's works, including Tsukihime , Fate/stay night , and The Garden of Sinners . An older Aoko Aozaki is an early mentor to Tsukihime protagonist Shiki Tohno, while an older Tōko Aozaki is an employer to Garden of Sinners protagonist Shiki Ryōgi. Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon- , the remake of Type-Moon 's Tsukihime dōjin visual novel game, launched in Japan for PlayStation 4 and Switch in August 2021. The game launched on PS4 and Switch in English in June 2024.

Mahōtsukai no Yoru was one of the first collaborations between Kinoko Nasu and artist Takashi Takeuchi in the mid-90s, preceding their founding of Type-Moon . Initially a novel, Nasu and Takeuchi only showed the draft to friends and did not officially release it. Type-Moon eventually developed it into a visual novel with graphics by Hirokazu Koyama that shipped in April 2012, with two sequels planned.

The story is noted for being one of the few tangible connections in the loosely connected "Nasuverse," the English-speaking fan term for the shared universe and cosmology in Type-Moon 's works, including Tsukihime , Fate/stay night , and The Garden of Sinners . An older Aoko Aozaki is an early mentor to Tsukihime protagonist Shiki Tohno, while an older Tōko Aozaki is an employer to Garden of Sinners protagonist Shiki Ryōgi. Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon- , the remake of Type-Moon 's Tsukihime dōjin visual novel game, launched in Japan for PlayStation 4 and Switch in August 2021. The game launched on PS4 and Switch in English in June 2024.

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Movie Hits Theaters Worldwide in January 2027, in North America on January 29
content:
Witch on the Holy Night anime movie will begin its worldwide theatrical release in January 2027, with Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment announcing release dates for multiple international markets. It will premiere in Japan on November 20, 2026.

The ufotable film will open in the United States and Canada on January 29, 2027. It will be available in Japanese with English subtitles as well as an English dub.

The announced international release schedule is:

• January 21: Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates

• January 26: Austria, Germany, German-speaking Switzerland

• January 27: France, Belgium, French-speaking Switzerland

• January 28: Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Central America, Ecuador, Colombia, Bolivia, Peru, Italy, Denmark, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Italian-speaking Switzerland, Australia, New Zealand

• January 29: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Finland, Poland, Sweden, India

• February 5: Spain, Kazakhstan

Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahoutsukai no Yoru ) is a visual novel originally developed by TYPE-MOON and written by Kinoko Nasu, best known for works like Fate/stay night and Tsukihime . The game first launched in Japan on April 12, 2012, with an English version released globally in December 2022. It also became available on Steam in 2023.

The visual novel features character designs by Hirokazu Koyama and a soundtrack composed by Hideyuki Fukasawa. The upcoming film adaptation is being produced by Ufotable, the studio behind titles like Demon Slayer and Fate/Zero.

title: Korean Culture Center to Host K-Comics Origin Exhibition in Los Angeles
content:
The Korean Culture Center Los Angeles, in collaboration with the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA), will host the 2026 K-Comics Origin Los Angeles – Korean Webtoon Experience Exhibition from September 11 to October 17.

The exhibition will explore the development of Korean comics into the webtoon format and feature three popular Korean webtoons: All of Us Are Dead , Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint , and Solo Leveling .

The exhibition will recreate characters and key scenes from the three series, allowing visitors to experience the worlds of the webtoons through physical installations and interactive kiosks. It will also showcase examples of webtoon intellectual properties expanding into other formats, including live-action series, animation, and games.

Dong-geun Joo, creator of All of Us Are Dead , will attend the exhibition's opening on September 11. He will discuss the creation of the webtoon and its expansion into the Netflix live-action series, as well as his experiences as a creator.

The exhibition will be held at the Korean Culture Center Los Angeles' second-floor Art Gallery. Admission is free.

All of Us Are Dead and Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint are available digitally on WEBTOON, and Solo Leveling is available on Tapas .

Ize Press publishes the Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint novel and webtoon series in print. Yen Press ' Yen On imprint publishes the Solo Leveling novel series in print and Ize Press publishes the webtoon series in print.

title: Web Novel, Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series The Ordinary Jackpot Debuts on September 10
content:
The Ordinary Jackpot , the live-action series based on the web novel and webtoon of the same name, will premiere on the Korean streaming platform TVING on September 10, with its first two episodes released exclusively on the service.

The series follows Eun-tae Gong (Jun-hyuk Lee), a department manager who has become burned out from his difficult life at work. After winning the lottery, his ordinary life and workplace begin to change.

The Ordinary Jackpot will release two episodes every Thursday at 6:00 p.m. KST on TVING. The series will also premiere on tvN on September 14 at 9:00 p.m. KST, airing Mondays and Tuesdays.

The story of the webtoon, drawn by Ugukjo and written by S.Inha, reads:

After years of hard work, Euntae Gong becomes the youngest team leader at Hongseong International, a major luxury brand licensing company. Instead of the success he envisioned, he's bombarded by office politics and constant pressure. When he unexpectedly wins 1.8 billion won in the lottery, he believes he's finally found an escape, but family troubles and a brand new outlook on life lead him back to the office where he and his unlikely team of underdogs battle the odds to succeed.

Fans can read the English version of the webtoon on WEBTOON , and watch the series on Rakuten Viki .

title: Pokémon Pokopia Game Introduces Accessories Included in Expansion Pass DLC Part 2
content:
Nintendo introduced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday the additional new features of the paid Expansion Pass DLC part 2 of Pokémon Pokopia , its cozy-style life simulation crafting game for the Pokémon franchise . The DLC part 2 includes accessories such as sunglasses, Sylveon ribbon, and bow tie. The DLC will also include Doduo, Skitty, Braixen, and more Pokémon.

The game's DLC part 2 will release later this year.

The game's paid Expansion Pass DLC added the underwater Bubbly Basin town on August 5 as part 1 of the pass, and it will add another town in 2027 as part 3. Purchasing the DLC gives players a bonus Dynamic Ditto print recipe and bonus Rare Pokémetal in-game. The free update that launched with part 1 of the DLC included new Pokémon such as Manaphy, Popplio, Mudkip, Chinchou, Lanturn, Buizel, Corphish, Totodile, Dhelmise, Golisopod, Corsola, Frillish, Lumineon, and Sharpedo.

The free update adds the ability for players to explore and build underwater in existing towns using the new ability to Dive.

The game launched for Nintendo Switch 2 on March 5 with a Game-Key Card release. Game-Key Cards are physical cartridges that do not actually contain a game, but rather, a key to unlock and play the digital version from Nintendo 's eShop. Koei Tecmo developed the game. Nintendo and The Pokémon Company announced in August the game has sold more than 5 million units worldwide in about four months.

The game introduces Professor Tangrowth, Peakychu, Mosslax, and Smearguru. They are variations of Tangrowth, Pikachu, Snorlax, and Smeargle, respectively.

The battle-focused game Pokémon Champions launched on iOS and Android on June 17. The game debuted for Switch on April 8.

The new Pokémon Winds/Waves games will launch for Switch 2 worldwide in 2027.

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Special Episode 63 Ending Featuring "friend" by Kyoko and Haru
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its special Episode 63 ending, featuring the song “friend” performed by Kyoko’s and Haru’s voice actresses, Yuna Inamura and Hitomi Yoshida. The original song by IDOLING!!! was used in Episodes 39-51, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the fifth ending featuring “Sakura addiction” by Takashi Kondo & Toshinobu Iida. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: Nintendo Reveals New Trailer, October 22 Launch for Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Game
content:
Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that Nintendo Switch Sports Resort , the successor game to Wii Sports Resort , will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 22. The company also revealed a new trailer for the game.

The video reveals that in addition to the 12 sports available to play in the game, players can also freely explore the game's setting of Wuhu Island. The video also introduces the game's new Island Crown mode.

The game's 12 sports are:

• Boxing

• Table Tennis

• Archery

• Tennis

• Volleyball

• Bowling

• Basketball

• Golf

• Thumb Wrestling

• Skateboarding

• Power Cruising

• Prop Plane

There is also a Jump Rope minigame for warming up.

Players can use either Sportsmates characters or regular Miis. The game takes place on Wuhu Island, the destination of the original Wii Sports Resort for Nintendo Wii. Wuhu Island also appears in other games such as Wii Fit , Mario Kart 8 Deluxe , and Super Smash Bros. Ultimate .

Nintendo Switch Sports , the successor to Nintendo 's Wii Sports game series, launched in April 2022. The game includes Soccer, Volleyball, Bowling, Tennis, Badminton, and Chambara (Swordplay). The game later added Golf and Basketball for a total of eight sports. The game introduced customizable Sportsmates avatars.

The original Wii Sports Resort debuted for Wii in Japan in June 2009 and in the West in July 2009. The game introduced the Wii MotionPlus technology for more accurate motion controls. The game included the following 12 sports: Swordplay, Wakeboarding, Frisbee, Archery, Basketball, Table Tennis, Golf, Bowling, Power Cruising, Canoeing, Cycling, and Air Sports.

Wii Sports debuted for Wii alongside the system's launch as a bundled game in 2006. The game included the following five sports: Tennis, Baseball, Bowling, Golf, and Boxing.
